name: GPU Marching Cubes with Lookup Tables
aliases: GPU Marching Cubes with Fixed-Size Buffer
definition: A GPU-based implementation of the Marching Cubes algorithm that uses pre-computed lookup tables stored in 2D textures to determine edge intersections and triangle configurations for a voxel grid.
summary: GPU Marching Cubes with Lookup Tables uses pre-computed tables in textures to determine voxel intersections via compute shaders, leveraging massive parallelism for efficient mesh generation.
